routes.label: at the Electoral Office in Basseterre or Charlestown: renewals done at once

note: St Kitts and Nevis' National Identification Card is issued by the Electoral Office to those qualified to vote, citizens of 18 and over among them; for nationals it is valid ten years (the Office's guide, 2007). The Office's notice of 30 October 2019: expired cards are renewed immediately at its offices in St Kitts and in Nevis, with no waiting period. No fee was found.

sources.title: Electoral Office of St Kitts and Nevis, Your National ID and You (guide, 2007; ACE Electoral Knowledge Network copy)
sources.said: For nationals, the cards will be valid for ... 10 years. For Commonwealth citizens, 5 ... Citizens of St. Kitts & Nevis 18

sources.title: SKNIS (St Kitts and Nevis Information Service), Notice from the Electoral Office of St Kitts and Nevis (30 October 2019)
sources.said: Persons renewing their expired National Identification Cards are advised that renewals are done immediately at our offices in St Kitts and in Nevis. There is no waiting period.
